title: metais.sample/1
description: What metais sample prints with --json: the generator's options and the files of the sample data it wrote (ADR-007 D9, ADR-008 D9).

optional.description: The optional-field mode the data was made with.

seed.description: The seed the data was made with, an unsigned 64-bit integer.

items.description: The number of items the generator aimed for in every array and collection.

example.description: The name of the example the data was saved as, or null for a data directory.

dry_run.description: Whether the files were only listed, and nothing was written.

files.description: Each file written, or that a dry run would write, as a path relative to the data directory or to the example's directory, in byte order; an empty directory, a collection with no item, ends in /.
